summary: Action and frame conventions verified empirically, not assumed. (1) default_pandaomron.json sets arms.right.type=OSC_POSE with input_type=delta and input_ref_frame=base, so action.end_effector_position is a BASE-FRAME DELTA -- the checkpoint's rep=ABSOLUTE describes GR00T's normalisation, not the controller. (2) state.end_effector_position_absolute equals the sim grip site exactly ([3.0463,-0.55,1.2928]), so 'absolute' is world frame. (3) base_rotation is xyzw ([0,0,0.7071,0.7071]) and R(base_rotation)^T @ (abs - base_position) reproduces end_effector_position_relative with error 0.00000, giving an exact world->base transform. Also: GR00T's wrapper image is the vertical flip of a raw MuJoCo render (mean|diff| 1.2 flipped vs 93 unflipped) and cameras render at 512 while the policy consumes downsampled 256 copies -- both calibrated per camera rather than assumed.
